newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkish Prime Minister Erbakan submits his resignation.
- Palestinian President Arafat arrives in the United Arab Emirates.
- United Arab Emirates' oil income in 1996 was worth $15 billion.
- Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah to visit Syria next week for talks on Middle East peace process.
- Jordanian prime minister expects a U.S. initiative to resume stalled Middle East peace process.
- Qatar sets up an industrial development bank with a paid-in capital of 200 million riyals.
- Saudi Aramco inaugurates an expansion project at a gas plant aimed at raising production to 200,000 barrels a day.
